title: Structure.
*Facilitate.*
Grow.
lede: One team owns the process end to end, so founders stay focused on the business, not the paperwork.

steps.title: Diagnose
steps.text: A 15-minute introductory session, then a review of your current ownership, instruments, agreements and capital requirement.

steps.title: Structure
steps.text: A custom equity framework: valuation scenarios, dilution modelling, share classes and instruments aligned to institutional standards.

steps.title: Facilitate
steps.text: We coordinate your CA, CS, legal counsel, registered valuers and investors through documentation, approvals and filings.

steps.title: Manage
steps.text: Ongoing cap-table maintenance, ESOP administration and clear ownership reporting for every stakeholder.
